keywords: EIP-8141 验证前缀禁用 SLOTNUM
summary: EIP-8141 的验证前缀把 `SLOTNUM` 加入禁用操作码列表并合并，理由与 `TIMESTAMP`、`NUMBER` 相同：其值在节点接收交易和交易被打包之间会变，前缀据此分支就可能模拟通过、上链回滚。EIP-8130 先后合并 Keystore 对齐和审计对齐两份 PR。当天有 Encrypt The Mempool #8、L1-zkEVM breakout #07、PQTS breakout #13 和 P2P networking #6 四场会议。

items.topic: 原生 AA 规范修补
items.title: EIP-8141：验证前缀执行期间禁用 SLOTNUM
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）合并。验证前缀已禁用在接收与打包之间会变值的操作码：`TIMESTAMP`、`NUMBER`、`PREVRANDAO`、`BASEFEE`、`BLOBBASEFEE`，依赖它们分支的前缀可能在接收时模拟通过、上链时回滚；`SLOTNUM` 具有同样性质，但列表写于它出现之前。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: ban SLOTNUM during validation-prefix execution
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), merged. The validation prefix already bans opcodes whose value changes between admission and inclusion: `TIMESTAMP`, `NUMBER`, `PREVRANDAO`, `BASEFEE`, `BLOBBASEFEE`; a prefix branching on them can pass simulation at admission and revert on inclusion. `SLOTNUM` has exactly that property but was missing because the list predates it.

items.note_en: Merged, followed by audit reconciliation (self-actor revoke, authenticator allowlist) (chunter-cb), submitted and merged the same day. It changes only the spec, not the contract, and simplifies `RevokeActor` to uniformly delete the actor config and its policy.

keywords_en: EIP-8141 bans SLOTNUM in validation prefixes
address poisoning and the gas limit
summary_en: EIP-8141's validation prefix added `SLOTNUM` to its banned opcodes, merged, for the same reason as `TIMESTAMP` and `NUMBER`: its value changes between a node admitting a transaction and its inclusion, so a prefix branching on it can pass simulation and revert onchain. EIP-8130 merged both its Keystore alignment PR and an audit reconciliation PR. Four calls took place: Encrypt The Mempool #8, L1-zkEVM breakout #07, PQTS breakout #13 and P2P networking #6.
